evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout on 8e01df9; contract 113 applied 5 August 2026. The lane derived the pending set and proved the migration additive by reading it before applying. Corroborated read-only afterwards: the ledger holds 113 rows through 20260805090000. public.competition_rounds carries both window columns, and EVERY round's window is NULL — the migration derives nothing on application, so the apply is behaviour-neutral. Both window CHECK constraints and the assert_round_window_disjoint trigger are bound. All three new predictor_internal objects are deployed BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed migration: assert_round_window_disjoint md5 2c22a154a61fc6b39ae20a8b752f09a9 over 748 characters, derive_round_play_windows 64deb5daed934fd765d9969b5de84f37 over 1456, and resolve_round_for_kickoff 791c216ea4c53be145e86ff5a6fb044f over 757. Each is security definer with search_path pinned to the empty string and granted to no browser or service role. The column addition widens nothing: competition_rounds holds zero grants to anon or authenticated, which the migration asserts in its own final block. Contract 112 remains intact beneath it.
